name: gitlab-self-hosted
description: Inspect and operate GitLab projects through the bundled production-oriented self-hosted MCP server with safe shared-token or per-user OAuth workflows for Codex and ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Self-hosted GitLab MCP with OAuth and CIMD
interface.longDescription: Use the bundled self-hosted GitLab MCP server to inspect projects, review merge requests, manage issues, operate repository files and pipelines, and publish controlled changes to GitLab.com or GitLab Self-Managed. The portable plugin intentionally does not bind an MCP endpoint or a user-specific ChatGPT MCP connection: configure the appropriate local, remote, or ChatGPT connection-bound variant for your environment. The distinct gitlab-self-hosted package identifier avoids collision with the OpenAI-curated GitLab plugin.
defaultPrompt: List the GitLab groups and projects I can access.
Review the current GitLab merge request and address feedback.
Create a GitLab issue or merge request after confirming the target.
